name: elephant
definition: A large, heavy mammal with a long trunk and large tusks.

name: to die
definition: To cease to live or to undergo the process of death.

name: deer (general)
definition: A hoofed mammal that typically has antlers and lives in forests or grasslands.

name: star
definition: A large, luminous ball of gas in space that shines in the night sky.

name: iron
definition: A hard, heavy, dark grey metal used to make tools, weapons, or machinery.

name: cheek
definition: The fleshy part of the face on either side of the nose and below the eyes.

name: path (road)
definition: A track or narrow way made for walking or travelling, often through a forest or field, that is smaller than a major road.

name: to winnow
definition: To blow air through a mixture of grain and husks to separate the edible part from the waste.

name: corpse
definition: The dead body of a human being that is no longer alive.

name: bear (animal)
definition: A large, heavy mammal with thick fur and strong limbs, often found in forests and known for eating honey or plants.

name: one
definition: The number that comes after zero and before two.

name: to spit
definition: To eject saliva or a small amount of liquid from the mouth by force.

name: younger sibling
definition: A person who has the same parents as you but was born after you.

name: hoe
definition: A hand tool used for digging or moving soil, consisting of a long handle with a metal blade at one end.

name: to sweat
definition: To exude moisture from the pores of the skin, typically due to heat, physical exertion, or illness.
burmese: ချွေးထွက်သည်

name: group (of people)
definition: A collection of several people who are together in one place or share a common purpose.

name: bird (general term)
definition: A warm-blooded vertebrate animal that has feathers and wings, and typically lays eggs.

name: to burn (intransitive)
definition: To undergo a process of combustion or to be consumed by fire.

name: grandchild
definition: The offspring of a person's child.

name: to come back (return)
definition: To move or travel from a place towards the place where one started or where one is currently located.

name: village
definition: A small human settlement, typically located in a rural area, consisting of a group of houses and their inhabitants.

name: language
definition: A system of sounds, words, and grammar used by a group of people to communicate.

name: brewed alcohol
definition: A liquid drink produced by the fermentation of grains, fruit, or sugar.
burmese: အချဉ်ဖောက်အရက်

name: stone
definition: A hard, solid, non-living mineral matter found in the ground or on the surface of the earth.

name: name
definition: A word or set of words used to identify a person, place, or thing.

name: to push
definition: To apply force against an object to move it away from oneself or to move it forward.

name: elder brother
definition: A male sibling who was born before the speaker.

name: water
definition: The clear, colourless liquid that falls from the sky as rain and is necessary for all living things to drink.

name: to embrace (hug)
definition: To wrap one's arms around a person's body to show affection or greeting.
burmese: ပွေ့ဖက်သည်

name: to write
definition: To mark words or symbols on a surface, such as paper or a digital screen, using a tool like a pen or pencil.

name: to tie (general)
definition: To fasten or secure two or more things together using a cord, string, or rope.

name: fruit
definition: The fleshy, edible part of a plant that contains seeds and grows from a flower.

name: to wash clothes
definition: To clean garments or pieces of fabric using water and a cleaning agent.

name: to emerge
definition: To move from a hidden or internal place into view.
burmese: ထင်ပေါ်လာသည်

name: moon
definition: The natural satellite that orbits the Earth and is visible in the night sky.

name: about
definition: Relating to a specific subject, or roughly approximating a number, time, or quantity.

name: eye
definition: The organ on the face used for seeing and perceiving light.

name: smoke
definition: The visible gas or vapour produced when a substance burns, often seen coming from a fire or an engine.

name: two
definition: The number that comes after one and before three.

name: man (male person)
definition: An adult human male.

name: sun
definition: The star at the centre of the solar system that provides light and heat to the earth during the day.

name: salt
definition: A white or translucent mineral used in small amounts to season or preserve food.

name: heart
definition: The muscular organ inside the chest that pumps blood through the body.

name: father
definition: A male parent.

name: porcupine
definition: A large rodent that has many sharp, hard spines covering its body for protection.

name: shadow (of something)
definition: A dark area or shape produced on a surface by an object that blocks light.
burmese: မှောင်ရိပ်

name: bed
definition: A piece of furniture used for sleeping or resting on.

name: to be red
definition: To have the colour of blood or a ripe tomato.

name: ten
definition: The number that comes after nine and before eleven.

name: distilled alcohol
definition: A liquid produced through a process of heating and cooling, often used as a strong alcoholic drink.
burmese: ပေါင်းခံအရက်

name: rice plant
definition: The plant that produces the grain used for food.

name: to be heavy
definition: To have a great weight or to be difficult to lift.

name: tomorrow
definition: The day after the current day.

name: seven
definition: The number that comes after six and before eight.

name: to hunt
definition: To chase, catch, or kill wild animals for food or for sport.
burmese: အမဲလိုက်သည်

name: to climb (wall)
definition: To move upwards by using hands and feet to grip a vertical surface.

name: to awaken
definition: To stop sleeping and become conscious or alert.

name: 2 sg
definition: The single person being spoken to.

name: to apply paint
definition: To spread paint or another colouring substance over a surface using a brush, hand, or other tool.

name: bat (animal)
definition: A nocturnal flying mammal with wings formed by skin stretched between its fingers.

name: forest (wild jungle)
definition: A large area of land covered with many trees and natural vegetation, not used for farming or human settlement.

name: to buy
definition: To give money to someone in exchange for an object or a service.

name: to ignite (something)
definition: To cause something to start burning or catch fire.

name: stick (tree)
definition: A thin, woody piece of a plant or a tree that has fallen or been broken off.

name: intestines
definition: The long, tube-like organs inside the abdomen that process food after it is swallowed.
